questions: I want the other breast gone. But I signed a paper in 2022 saying I didn't want the prophylactic surgery. The insurance is going to say it's 'cosmetic' now, aren't they? They will say I missed my chance and I have to wait for cancer to grow before they pay. Do I have to hire a lawyer just to get life-saving surgery? Or do I have to lie and say I found a lump just to get them to approve the operation?

This Zoladex shot is chemical castration. My gynecologist says I need it because my tumor was 'highly hormone positive.' But I am 45 and I feel 80. My husband is patient, but for how long? If I stop the shots and just take the Tamoxifen, will the cancer come back immediately?

My father had breast cancer. I had breast cancer. We literally have the same scar on the same side. It feels... incestuous, like we are sharing this sick bond. When I look at his scar, I want to vomit. Is it normal to be disgusted by your own father because he gave you this?
